notes: This amendment defines hierarchical personal-workspace, company-workspace, and brand provider connection ownership. Existing operational workspace_type semantics remain unchanged; personal/company ownership uses a separate workspace_ownership_type dimension. The contract requires immutable selected owner-scope evidence, two-stage readiness with guarded credential materialization, reconnect target/revision/provider-account binding, separately authorized migration readback before dependent runtime rollout, and exact-owner isolation during rollback. Runtime implementation is split across governed PRs for persistence, migration application, tenant OAuth, context resolution, authority and capability integration, readiness, activation, OpenAPI compatibility, tests, rollout, production verification, and post-merge audit. No migration, provider call, credential mutation, deployment, or protected-branch write is performed by this specification branch.
